instructions: Accept equivalent meanings and graph structures, not exact words or counts.
All members of one required evidence bundle are required; multiple bundles represent alternative sufficient sets.
If evidence delivery or technical validity is not established, mark affected target not_testable rather than model failure.
Structural citation checks do not assess entailment, causal validity or question quality.
No forced complete board at V1. Keep all derivatives of the same incident in the development split.
